evals.name: impact-question-needs-two-hops
evals.prompt: We're about to change how `verify_token` works. What would break? Our skardi-server is on http://127.0.0.1:8080 and it has our code knowledge graph registered.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the graph vocabulary first (graph_schema + edge counts), seeds on the named entity, expands INCOMING call edges with a bounded Cypher, and reports the dependents with the traversal and its bound attached. Must not present an unordered LIMIT slice as the complete answer.

evals.name: vague-question-needs-semantic-seeding
evals.prompt: Which parts of our codebase deal with authentication, and what calls into them? skardi-server at http://127.0.0.1:8080.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the question is too vague for a property lookup, so hop 1 uses a search surface to find seeds, verifies the seeds resolve in the graph before expanding, then expands. Reports unresolved seeds rather than hiding them.

evals.name: row-question-should-hand-off
evals.prompt: How many orders did we get last month, broken down by status? skardi-server at http://127.0.0.1:8080.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a rows-not-edges question and does NOT run a graph traversal — either hands off to the retrieval skill or answers with plain read-only SQL. Should not invent a graph angle.
